alignments.note: וְלֹא → *nor* fused, headed on the negative (r35).

Resumed subject: the closing *He is witness* supplies a subject denoting Jehovah, named earlier in the verse, so *He* joins the name's discontinuous unit (r25). Competing reading: *He* `added`.
3ms verb rendered *they said*; the pronoun realizes the verb's subject (r17).

Cleft dummy *It*; no morpheme licenses it (r20). The copula is not added with it: the main clause יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה is verbless, so rule 20's cleft sentence leaves the copula to the clause's own anchor.

Verbless clause: the construction-supplied *is* joins Jehovah, the only overt anchor free to bear it, since the predicate relative clause already carries its own finite verb (r20 tripartite/elided-predicate reasoning). Competing reading: *It is* as one added cleft unit.
Margin *Or, made* read and set aside (r38).
Hiphil עלה → *brought ... up*; *up* completes the lexeme (r44), discontinuous around the object (r25).

review_notes: Corrected the cleft: the Hebrew main clause is verbless, so under rule 20 only the dummy *It* is added and the copula *is* joins Jehovah as the clause's overt anchor; the written אֲשֶׁר takes *that*.

variant_decisions.evidence: ASV 'And they cried unto Jehovah, and said' makes 'said' a second predicate of the plural subject 'they', matching the qere plural וַיֹּאמְרוּ; the ketiv singular ויאמר ('and he said') would require a singular subject the ASV does not supply.

alignments.note: מִן takes the contextual spatial relation on under rule 11; the ASV locates the enemies in the surrounding domain.
סָבִיב supplies every side, headed on side. Unlike an indivisible round about, this rendering separately names the surrounding domain and states its relation with on.
*And when* pair for the one waw (r55), headed on the coordinator; competing head *when*.
Rectum takes *of*; supplied *the* on this inner construct (r29).
Apodosis waw; ASV opens *ye said* with no connective (r14).
Nominal predicate takes the copula (r20); discontinuous around the possessive.
Hebrew juxtaposes the two relative clauses with no waw; the coordinating *and* is supplied (r14).
*asked for*: the *for* is the English verb's own reach to the relativized object (r44).
Marker takes the *against* the English verb needs to reach its object (r16).
הָיָה → *be*; discontinuous across the coordinated subject (r25). Margin *then shall both ye...* read and set aside (r38).
אַחַר of *be after* recast as *followers of*; the preposition's relation is what the phrase renders, headed on *followers* (r24 fixed-phrase head).
Apodosis *well* supplied by the ASV (italic); no morpheme licenses it (r7, r30).
Marker takes the *against* the English verb needs (r16).

הָיְתָה governs both coordinated phrases; the ASV realizes it as *will ... be* over the first and as *was* over the second member it recasts as a clause, so both belong to the verb's one discontinuous unit (r34 distributed verb, r25). Competing reading: *it was* as one added unit.
The *it* of *as it was* resumes *the hand* named earlier in the verse and joins the noun's discontinuous unit, headed on the lexeme-bearing word (r25 resumed nominal). Competing reading: *it* added.
The waw of the coordinated phrase is rendered by the comparative connective *as* (r14 open list).

review_notes: Corrected the *as it was* recasting: *was* is a second realization of the one written הָיְתָה over the coordinated member (r34/r25), and *it* resumes יַד named earlier in the verse (r25); nothing is added. The waw keeps *as*.

alignments.note: גַּם־עַתָּה → *Now therefore*: עַתָּה writes its own *Now*, גַּם takes the connective left over (r14 two-word clause-head reasoning).
*stand still* one rendering of the Hithpael (r44).
לְ → *before*; *eyes* is written for the noun, so no fusion.

Impersonal *it* in a verbless clause; no morpheme licenses it (r20).

waw of the jussive rendered as purpose *that* (r14).
Supplied determiner *this* (italic) joins the bare noun it determines (r15); no demonstrative morpheme is present. Competing reading: *this* `added`.
Emphatic explicit pronoun; the ASV's *indeed* is what it spends on that emphasis, so it joins the pronoun's discontinuous unit. Competing reading: *indeed* `added`.

Supplied clause *then would ye go* (italic); the Hebrew has no verb here, only כִּי אַחֲרֵי (r20, r2 one added run).

תֹּהוּ → *vain things*; *things* is the supplied generic, head on *vain* (r31).

בְּ → *for* independently renders the causal relation; עֲבוּר takes its own *sake*. Unlike an indivisible compound rendering, each morpheme owns an English word, so rules 2, 11 and 30 require separate units.
עֲבוּר → *sake* retains the construct noun's nominal rendering; its rectum is separately realized by *name's*.
Agreement article on the adjective; the suffix supplies the determiner (r41).

*as for* before a fronted pronoun no marker or preposition stands on (r16 third-family limit).
